command_line_option.name: help
command_line_option.help_msg: Prints this message.

command_line_option.name: showTemplates
command_line_option.help_msg: Prints and generates an xml file both containing a list of the available example templates, organized per language, that can be used with Code Generator -exampleTemplate option.

command_line_option.name: allocateWithMalloc
command_line_option.help_msg: Use this flag to get backwards compatibility when allocating optional members with DDS_Heap_malloc in C++ (CODEGENII-620).

command_line_option.name: autoGenFiles
command_line_option.help_msg: Updates the autogenerated files, i.e, typefiles and makefile/project files shortcut for: -update <typefiles> -update <makefiles> -platform <arch>"

command_line_option.name: create
command_line_option.help_msg: Creates the files indicated if they do not exist. For example: rtiddsgen -language C -create typefiles test.idl If the files already exist, the files are not modified and a warning is printed. There can be multiple -create options. If you specify both -create and -update for the same file type, only the -update will be applied.

command_line_option.name: convertToIdl
command_line_option.help_msg: Converts the input file into an equivalent IDL file.

command_line_option.name: convertToXml
command_line_option.help_msg: Converts the input file into an equivalent XML file.

command_line_option.name: convertToXsd
command_line_option.help_msg: Converts the input file into an equivalent XSD file.

command_line_option.name: xmlTypeLibrary
command_line_option.help_msg: When generating XML use the type_library format instead of the types format

command_line_option.name: D
command_line_option.help_msg: Defines preprocessor macros

command_line_option.name: d
command_line_option.help_msg: Generate output in the specified directory (default: IDL input file's directory)

command_line_option.name: use52CKeyhash
command_line_option.help_msg: This flag is ignored

command_line_option.name: use52JavaKeyhash
command_line_option.help_msg: This option should be used when compatibility with 5.2.3 and earlier GARs is required when using keyed mutable types. Deprecate, use -use52Keyhash

command_line_option.name: use52Keyhash
command_line_option.help_msg: This option should be used when compatibility with 5.2.3 and earlier GARs is required when using keyed mutable types (CODEGENII-501 and CODEGENII-693)

command_line_option.name: use526Keyhash
command_line_option.help_msg: This option should be used when compatibility with 5.2.6 is required when using keyed mutable types (CODEGENII-693)

command_line_option.name: dllExportMacroSuffix
command_line_option.help_msg: Defines the suffix of the macro that is used to export symbols when building Windows DLLs. The default macro is NDDS_USER_DLL_EXPORT. When this option is specified, the name of the macro is NDDS_USER_DLL_EXPORT_<Suffix>

command_line_option.name: enableEscapeChar
command_line_option.help_msg: Enables the usage of the escape character '_' in IDL identifiers.

command_line_option.name: example
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates type files, example files and makefile shortcut for: -create <typefiles> -create <examplefiles> -create <makefiles> -platform <arch> Valid <arch> arguments are: For all languages but C#: universal (Generate compatible publisher/subscriber code for all supported platforms. It won't generate makefiles/project files)

command_line_option.name: exampleTemplate
command_line_option.help_msg: Generate an example application using custom publisher and subscriber templates. You can also optionally add a QoS template. These templates should be saved under: $NDDSHOME/resource/app/app_support/rtiddsgen/templates/example/<language>/<templateName> This option is not supported in Ada. In order to use this option, you have to use one of the next ones: -create examplefiles -update examplefiles -example <architecture>

command_line_option.name: express
command_line_option.help_msg: This flag is ignored

command_line_option.name: generateCTypeCode
command_line_option.help_msg: This flag is ignored

command_line_option.name: I
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds the directory to the list of directories to be searched for header files

command_line_option.name: inputIdl
command_line_option.help_msg: Indicates that the input file is an IDL file independently of the file extension

command_line_option.name: inputXml
command_line_option.help_msg: Indicates that the input file is an XML file independently of the file extension

command_line_option.name: inputXsd
command_line_option.help_msg: Indicates that the input file is an XSD file independently of the file extension

command_line_option.name: inputProto
command_line_option.help_msg: Indicates that the input file is a proto file independently of the file extension

command_line_option.name: j
command_line_option.help_msg: Sets the number of files that rtiddsgen will process concurrently. When multiple files are provided, either as a folder or a list of files, rtiddsgen will handle them simultaneously. Similarly, if rtiddsgen_server is used and there are multiple requests, it will process them concurrently, resulting in multiple IDLs being processed at the same time. By default (if you do not specify -j), rtiddsgen processes up to 4 files concurrently.

command_line_option.name: language
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates output for one of: C, C++

command_line_option.name: namespace
command_line_option.help_msg: This parameter should be included to use C++ namespaces when the language option is C++

command_line_option.name: constructor
command_line_option.help_msg: This parameter should be used to generate type default constructor, copy constructor, copy assignment operator, and destructor when the language option is C++. The usage of this option will disable the generation of the following TypeSupport methods: create_data(_ex), delete_data(_ex), initialize_data(_ex) finalize_data(_ex), copy_data

command_line_option.name: virtualDestructor
command_line_option.help_msg: This parameter should be used to generate a virtual destructor when the language option is C++. The usage of this option will automatically enable constructor generation (-constructor). Notice that the usage of this option will affect the filtering performance when using ContentFilterTopics or QueryConditions.

command_line_option.name: useStdString
command_line_option.help_msg: Uses 'std::string' instead of 'char *' when generating code for IDL strings when the language option is C++. The usage of this option will automatically enable constructor generation (-constructor)

command_line_option.name: plugableTypesPath
command_line_option.help_msg: Defines the templates path to load pluggable types

command_line_option.name: alwaysUseStdVector
command_line_option.help_msg: When -language C++11 is specified, map all sequences to 'std::vector', even bounded sequences that would otherwise map to 'rti::core::bounded_sequence.' Alternatively, the @use_vector annotation can be applied to each sequence member

command_line_option.name: obfuscate
command_line_option.help_msg: obfuscate the input IDL file

command_line_option.name: optimization
command_line_option.help_msg: Level of optimization of the code generation 0: No Optimization. 1: The compiler generates extra code for typedefs but optimizes its use. If a type that is used is a typedef that can be resolved to a primitive, enum, or aggregated type (struct, union, or value type), the generated code will invoke the code of the most basic type to which the typedef can be resolved. This level can be used if the generated code is not expected to be modified. This is the only optimization level supported for Java, C#, and C++/CLI languages.

command_line_option.name: optimizeAlignment
command_line_option.help_msg: This flag is ignored

command_line_option.name: package
command_line_option.help_msg: Uses <packagePrefix> as the root package (Java only)

command_line_option.name: platform
command_line_option.help_msg: Required if -create makefiles or -update makefiles is used. Valid <arch> arguments are the same as those in the -example <arch>

command_line_option.name: ppNotRun
command_line_option.help_msg: Option to not run the preprocessor. This option is deprecated, please use -ppDisable

command_line_option.name: ppDisable
command_line_option.help_msg: Option to not run the preprocessor

command_line_option.name: ppPath
command_line_option.help_msg: Preprocessor path The default value is "cpp" for non-Windows architectures and "cl.exe" for Windows architectures. If you use -ppPath to provide the full path and filename for "cl.exe" or the cpp preprocessor, you must also use -ppOption (described below) to set the following preprocessor options:" If you use a non-default path for \"cl.exe\", you also need to set: -ppOption nologo -ppOption /C -ppOption /E -ppOption /X If you use a non-default path for cpp, you also need to set: -ppOption -C

command_line_option.name: ppOption
command_line_option.help_msg: Preprocessor option

command_line_option.name: protocPath
command_line_option.help_msg: Protoc compiler path By default rtiddsgen will use the Protoc executable in the path. If you want to use an specif version not included in the path, use -protoPath to provide the full path and filename.

command_line_option.name: protocOption
command_line_option.help_msg: Protoc compiler option. This option will be passed to the Protoc compiler.

command_line_option.name: qualifiedEnumerator
command_line_option.help_msg: Uses the fully qualified name for enumerator values including the enum value.

command_line_option.name: replace
command_line_option.help_msg: Deprecated option. Please use -update for the proper files (typefiles, examplefiles, makefiles). This option is maintained for backwards compatibility. It allows rtiddsgen to overwrite any existing generated files. If you do not use this option and existing files are found, rtiddsgen will print a warning but will not overwrite the files.

command_line_option.name: sequenceSize
command_line_option.help_msg: Size assigned to unbounded sequences. The default value is 100.

command_line_option.name: sharedLib
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates makefile compiling with the dynamic libraries.

command_line_option.name: stringSize
command_line_option.help_msg: Size assigned to unbounded strings. The default value is 255.

command_line_option.name: typeSequenceSuffix
command_line_option.help_msg: Assigns a suffix to the name of the implicit sequence defined for IDL types. The option is compatible with languages C and C++. By default, the suffix is 'Seq'. For example, given the type 'Foo' the name of the sequence would be 'FooSeq'.

command_line_option.name: typeSizes
command_line_option.help_msg: Displays the maximum serialized size, minimum serialized size, and maximum key serialized size of all the complex types of an idl.

command_line_option.name: U
command_line_option.help_msg: Cancels any previous definition of name.

command_line_option.name: update
command_line_option.help_msg: Creates the files indicated if they do not exist. For example: rtiddsgen -language C -update typefiles test.idl If the files already exist, -update overwrites the files without printing a warning. There can be multiple -update options. If both -create and -update are specified for the same file type, only the -update will be applied.

command_line_option.name: unboundedSupport
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates code that supports unbounded sequences and strings. This option is not supported in Ada. When this option is used, the command-line options sequenceSize and stringSize are ignored. This option also affects the way unbounded sequences are deserialized. When a sequence is being received into a sample from the DataReader's cache, the old memory for the sequence will be deallocated and memory of sufficient size to hold the deserialized data will be allocated. When initially constructed, sequences will not preallocate any elements having a maximum of zero elements.

command_line_option.name: use42eAlignment
command_line_option.help_msg: This option has been removed from codegen

command_line_option.name: V
command_line_option.help_msg: Defines a user variable that can be used in the templates as $userVarList.name or $userVarList.name.equals(value).

command_line_option.name: verbosity
command_line_option.help_msg: rtiddsgen verbosity 1: exceptions 2: exceptions + warnings 3: exceptions + warnings + information The default value is 3.

command_line_option.name: version
command_line_option.help_msg: Prints the rtiddsgen version.

command_line_option.name: reader
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates support for DataReader (only with -micro).

command_line_option.name: writer
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates support for DataWriter (only with -micro).

command_line_option.name: micro
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates code and support files for RTI Connext Micro, instead of RTI Connext. Use -micro -help to list command-line arguments supported by rtiddsgen when targeting RTI Connext Micro.

command_line_option.name: strict
command_line_option.help_msg: Enables strict XType specification compliant checks.

command_line_option.name: uniqueNames
command_line_option.help_msg: Generate unique names for TS types. This flag is only available for FACE C++. This feature is an RTI extension and it is not specified in the FACE Technical Standard 3.1.

command_line_option.name: r
command_line_option.help_msg: Recursive search for input files in directories.

command_line_option.name: generateIncludeFiles
command_line_option.help_msg: Generate code for any file included in the inputs files

command_line_option.name: exampleFACEConfig
command_line_option.help_msg: Generate an example configuration for FACE C.

command_line_option.name: allowedDataRepresentation
command_line_option.help_msg: Generate code for only one data representation. This option may improve performance because the generated code will not check the data representation during the serialization/deserialization.

command_line_option.name: allowedEndian
command_line_option.help_msg: Generate code for an specific endian. This option may improve performance because the generated code will not check endian during the serialization/deserialization.

command_line_option.name: noTypeFilesGeneration
command_line_option.help_msg: Rtiddsgen will not generate non essential type files for FACE TSS.

command_line_option.name: noTypePluginFilesGeneration
command_line_option.help_msg: Rtiddsgen will not generate type files plugin for FACE TSS.

command_line_option.name: standard
command_line_option.help_msg: Define the mapping for an specific standard. This flag is only supported in C++11. The options are DDS_PSM_Cxx for the default mapping in connextdds 7.5.0 an earlier. Use IDL4_CPP for the new standard mapping defined by the OMG in 2023. When -standard is not specified, the default value is IDL4_CPP.

command_line_option.name: ignoreSpecWarnings
command_line_option.help_msg: Rtiddsgen will not show any warning when the input file is not complient with the IDL/XTypes specification.

command_line_option.name: noSysPathGeneration
command_line_option.help_msg: Rtiddsgen will not generate syspath instructions for the Python imports. This command line option is only valid for Python.

command_line_option.name: joinInputFiles
command_line_option.help_msg: Rtiddsgen will join the input files and include files and process them together to create just an output file that contains all the generated code. This command line option is only valid for Python code generation.

command_line_option.name: joinedFilesOutputName
command_line_option.help_msg: Rtiddsgen will use the provided name when the commandline option joinInputFiles is used to designate the output files.

command_line_option.name: xTypesComplianceMask
command_line_option.help_msg:
Code Generator and the 'Extensible and Dynamic Topic Types for DDS' specification versions have evolved over time, causing some compliance gaps depending on the Connext and specification versions. Using this option, you can set or unset compliance with the latest implemented specification or with previous Connext versions that were not compliant. The value for this option must be the same as set by the mask in the Core Libraries.
See "Extensible Types Compliance Mask" in the "Data Representation" section, in the RTI Connext Core Libraries Extensible Types Guide, for more information about the default value of this mask and the meaning of each bit.

command_line_option.name: useNativeUnions
command_line_option.help_msg: Rtiddsgen will use C/C++ unions instead of structs with a discriminator field.

command_line_option.name: additionalSourceFiles
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds a list of sources separated by spaces to the makefile/project file sources to be compiled.

command_line_option.name: additionalHeaderFiles
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds a list of headers separated by spaces to the makefile/project file headers.

command_line_option.name: additionalDefines
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds a list of defines separated by spaces to the makefile/project file preprocessor definitions.

command_line_option.name: additionalLibraries
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds a list of libraries separated by spaces to the makefile/project file libraries Similar to -additionalRtiLibraries without the 'z' 'd' RTI conventions.

command_line_option.name: additionalRtiLibraries
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds a list of RTI library base names separated by spaces to the makefile/project file libraries. On Linux these base names will be added to the makefile with '-l' and suffixed with 'z', 'd', '.a' as appropriate. On Windows these base names will be suffixed with 'z', 'd' and '.lib' as appropriate.

command_line_option.name: additionalLibraryPaths
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds a list of library paths separated by spaces to the makefile/project file library paths.

command_line_option.name: addPackageToTypecode
command_line_option.help_msg: Add Package to type code name (Java only)

command_line_option.name: buildtype
command_line_option.help_msg: Define the buildfiles to be generated. The options are: default (makefiles for Linux and Visual Studio for Windows), makefiles, CMakeLists and Visual Studio.

command_line_option.name: helpHidden
command_line_option.help_msg: Prints this message.

command_line_option.name: printSupportedPlatforms
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates an xml file on the working directory containing all the list of supported platforms. It can also be used with the option -d in order to generate the file in a different directory.

command_line_option.name: metp
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds nddsmetp to RTI Libraries

command_line_option.name: generateTestCode
command_line_option.help_msg: For each type Foo, generate a function rti::test::initialize_test_values<Foo>() that initializes Foo's fields with non-default values (modern C++ only)

command_line_option.name: interpreted
command_line_option.help_msg: [0-1] Indicates whether or not the serialization/deserialization must be interpreted

command_line_option.name: openssl
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds to projectfiles the necesary OpenSSL parameters to compile a security example.

command_line_option.name: sourceDir
command_line_option.help_msg: Modify the makefiles to point to the specified source code

command_line_option.name: ttGuard
command_line_option.help_msg: This option create the identifier for the rtiddsgen execution from the time stamp execution

command_line_option.name: server
command_line_option.help_msg: Run codegen server

command_line_option.name: serverPort
command_line_option.help_msg: Port where codegen server will be listening

command_line_option.name: serverTimeout
command_line_option.help_msg: Number of milliseconds it takes codegen server to stop after the last call

command_line_option.name: serverLogFilePath
command_line_option.help_msg: Path to the log file of codegen server

command_line_option.name: rpcForMonitoring
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates code for the interfaces on monitoring. This option is only available for C.

command_line_option.name: rpcTest
command_line_option.help_msg: This option changes the generated code, to be able to run RPC tests

command_line_option.name: preComputeTypeSizes
command_line_option.help_msg: Outputs the precalculated type sizes of get_sample_max_size get_sample_min_size and get_sample_key_max_size methods in the generated code. When running with debug verbosity it also outputs a report of all the IDL type sizes

command_line_option.name: noCodeGeneration
command_line_option.help_msg: Avoids the generation of typefiles. DEPRECATED use -create <makefiles>

command_line_option.name: noDefaultNddshome
command_line_option.help_msg: Avoids the generation a default NDDSHOME in the project/makefiles

command_line_option.name: makefileOnly
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates project files without needing an IDL file.

command_line_option.name: libSuffix
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds the desired libsuffix to the core libraries (removing leading and trailing whitespace) Use -libSuffix d for debug. Use -sharedLib for dynamic -libSuffix " is ignored in MS Windows project files.

command_line_option.name: modifyPubData
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds the text in the generated publisher after the /*Modify your data here*/.

command_line_option.name: modifySubLoop
command_line_option.help_msg: Adds the text in the generated subscriber after the output that prints sleeping for a few seconds.

command_line_option.name: makefile
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates makefile/project files for the architecture. Deprecated use -create <makefiles>

command_line_option.name: disableBeautifier
command_line_option.help_msg: Disables the code beautifier (default in Ada)

command_line_option.name: disableXSDValidation
command_line_option.help_msg: When this option is used, rtiddsgen does not check that the input XSD file is well-formed. The use of this option is not recommended in general as the code generation may receive invalid inputs.

command_line_option.name: xmlWithOnlineXsd
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates XML and QoS with online version of the XSD schema.

command_line_option.name: convertToMonitoringIdl
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates monitoring distribution IDL file.

command_line_option.name: generateMonitoringCode
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates monitoring related code for an IDL file.

command_line_option.name: generateMonitoringIdHeader
command_line_option.help_msg: Generates monitoring ID header file.

command_line_option.name: workingDirectory
command_line_option.help_msg: Specifies the working directory and convert relative path arguments to absolute path.

command_line_option.name: notypecode
command_line_option.help_msg: Only valid for Java. This flag will prevent the typecode generation. Any call to getTypecode will return null. It may reduce significatively the memory usage. This flag requires set max typecode sizes to 0 in the QoS

command_line_option.name: versionNumber
command_line_option.help_msg: Prints just rtiddsgen version number.
